answer: An hostile operator hence has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The zenith counter is kept in trellis and tundra shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 268 aliases cost 243 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
